coverageNotes: Tests applying public/internal builder visibility; does not implement six functions or assess authorization logic.

questions.question: Which functions can an unauthenticated ordinary client invoke directly, using the matching query, mutation or action client method?

options.rationale: Internal registrations are rejected for ordinary client calls even when their names are known.
A public action is also client-callable; actions are not restricted to backend callers.
The three public registrations are directly callable. Internal registrations are not.
Public functions do not require authentication unless the handler enforces it.
